name: analysis
character: How a reel is read: probe rate, cut detection, shot scale, speech activity and the beat-grid phase fit. Numbers only; no decision about music is made here.

detector.name: scdet
detector.note: scdet is the default and the fallback. A deep detector (TransNetV2 class) is opt-in only, because it needs TensorFlow and 1.4 GB of weights; the reference F1 scores are why it is worth offering, not a promise this skill ships it.

sources: https://ffmpeg-cookbook.com/en/articles/scene-detect/ (scdet threshold 0-100, default 10, 8-14 for film; fades and dissolves missed)
https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3664647.3685517 (TransNet V2, ACM MM 2024: F1 96.2 on BBC Planet Earth, 77.9 on ClipShots)

provenance.shot_scale.grid: 16x9 blocks over a 320x180 analysis frame: starting value
provenance.shot_scale.peak_frac: starting value: a cell below half the peak contrast is background, so a flat background cannot become the subject through the quantile
provenance.shot_scale.focus_floor: starting value: below this block contrast nothing is treated as subject
provenance.shot_scale.wide_min: starting value, to be calibrated on real reels
provenance.shot_scale.medium_min: starting value, to be calibrated on real reels
provenance.shot_scale.close_min: starting value, to be calibrated on real reels
provenance.speech.threshold_db: starting value relative to the reel's own 95th percentile
provenance.phase_fit.tolerance_frames: starting value: one frame at any rate is the sync unit the gate judges in
